rules.statement: Orders in lunacy are admissible as prima facie evidence and, if uncontradicted, should be regarded as sufficient evidence of the facts recited in them which are essential to their validity.
rules.supporting_quote: "They are admissible as prima facie evidence, and if uncontradicted. they ought to be regarded as sufficient evidence of those facts, not only in this country, but in all His Majesty's dominions."
